component.name: Z13-Helper
component.summary: Hardware control GUI for the ASUS ROG Flow Z13 (2025)

description.p: Z13-Helper is a system-tray GUI for the 2025 ASUS ROG Flow Z13 running SteamOS or other Linux distributions. It exposes the hardware controls that are otherwise only reachable through the z13ctl CLI.

ul.li: Profiles (Silent / Balanced / Turbo / Boondock + your own): platform profile, power limits, fan curve, undervolt, lighting, battery limit and enter/exit hooks in one pick
Max Fans (both fans at 100%), per profile, with a fan watchdog
Keyboard and rear-lightbar brightness, per device, with automatic recovery of a wedged lightbar
Live APU temp, GPU temp, and dual-fan RPM telemetry
SPL / sPPT / fPPT power limits and a draggable 8-point fan curve (Fans + Power window)
CPU undervolt / Curve Optimizer offset (when ryzen_smu is loaded)
Armoury Crate side button opens the window (host evdev reader)
Updates panel: upstream watch, z13ctl / Decky Loader / SteamOS installers, Repair install
Desktop Mode app; Game Mode is covered by the companion Decky plugin

description.p: Renamed to Z13-Helper. The app is running after every switch to Desktop Mode. One fan watchdog shared with the Decky plugin, plus a fan trace for troubleshooting. Screen brightness slider.
Crash and error log: app log, crash reports for uncaught errors and hard crashes, and a Help → Error log window with an error badge. The wedged-lightbar recovery now also restarts the z13ctl daemon.

ul.li: Main window and Fans + Power window laid out after G-Helper; draggable fan curve, SPL/sPPT/fPPT sliders
Profiles engine (also the host z13-profile CLI): Boondock is now a profile; per-profile Max Fans (Turbo ships with it on)
Fan watchdog: recovers dropped curves, 0-RPM stalls and a frozen tach with a platform-profile rewrite plus the curve
Updates panel with installers for z13ctl, Decky Loader and SteamOS, and a Repair install button
One-shot install.sh / --repair with a verify report
Decky plugin parity: profiles, TDP, charge limit, per-device brightness, telemetry
Wedged rear lightbar recovered automatically (USB reset through a root oneshot + polkit rule)
Single instance; side button read directly from evdev on the host; z13ctl 1.4.2 with its daemon

description.p: Initial Flatpak release — Dashboard tab (profile, battery, brightness, telemetry), Advanced tab (TDP, fan curve, undervolt), system tray, side-button toggle.
